basics.name: Harsh Lara
basics.label: Tech Lead, AI & Machine Learning Systems
basics.summary: AI and ML systems leader with zero-to-one experience across Google, Resolve AI, Microsoft, and Apple. Works the full generative AI stack, from algorithmic foundations through to autonomous agentic systems in production.

work.name: Google
highlights: Autonomous threat detection and infrastructure remediation agents, closing the loop from security telemetry to automated mitigation.
Sandboxed Docker world runners and automated online verifiers for end-to-end reasoning, tool-use accuracy, and agent reliability.
Controllable LLM user simulators and multi-step API refinement models for technical investigation and triage.

work.name: Resolve AI
highlights: Early technical hire. Scaled from Seed ($115M) to Series A ($1.5B), backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, DST Global, and Jeff Dean.
Architected and shipped the mitigations system: autonomous agents that resolve production incidents end to end, cutting customer MTTR.
Drove the feature launches that onboarded Coinbase, DoorDash, and MongoDB.
Owned evaluation strategy across the agentic stack: investigation, root cause analysis, mitigation accuracy, agent reliability. Represented Resolve AI at HumanX 2026.

work.name: Google DeepMind
highlights: Led post-training tool-use and hallucination reduction for Project Astra and Gemini Live, including Google Workspace integrations.
Co-led MoDE (Mixture of Dyadic Experts), a multi-task PEFT architecture beating prior methods across 700+ tasks (NAACL 2025).
Core contributor to OmegaPRM and step-wise DPO. MCTS-based process supervision lifted Gemini math reasoning to 69.4% on MATH500 (+18.4) and 93.6% on GSM8K (+7.2).
Efficient decoding via early-exit chain-of-thought adaptors and self-improving LLM feedback loops.
Built RecLLM for YouTube recommendations on LaMDA, plus a controllable user simulator for CRS training and evaluation.

work.name: Microsoft
highlights: Drove AutoML product strategy, shipping Classification, Regression, and Data Labeling as managed cloud services.
Tech Lead and Applied Sciences Lead across multiple AutoML initiatives, from applied research to enterprise production.
Built deep learning infrastructure that improved training and inference throughput for text data-labeling pipelines.

work.name: Apple
highlights: Dynamic on-device interpolation of probabilistic language models, a >15% multi-domain gain in ASR accuracy.

publications.name: MoDE: Effective Multi-task Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with a Mixture of Dyadic Experts
publications.summary: A multi-task parameter-efficient fine-tuning architecture using a mixture of dyadic experts, outperforming existing methods across 700+ tasks.

publications.name: Improve Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models by Automated Process Supervision (OmegaPRM)
publications.summary: A divide-and-conquer MCTS algorithm for automated process supervision, lifting Gemini math reasoning by +18.4% on MATH500 and +7.2% on GSM8K.

publications.name: Leveraging Large Language Models in Conversational Recommender Systems (RecLLM)
publications.summary: An LLM-based conversational recommender system for YouTube video recommendations built on LaMDA.

publications.name: Evaluation of Synthetic Datasets for Conversational Recommender Systems
publications.publisher: NeurIPS 2022 (Synthetic Data for Empowering ML Research)
publications.summary: A controllable LLM-based user simulator addressing data scarcity in conversational recommender system training and evaluation.

publications.name: Patent: Neural Networks with Effective Parameter Efficient Adaptations
publications.summary: Parameter-efficient adaptation methods for neural networks.

publications.name: Patent: Efficient Decoding of Output Sequences Using Early Exit Adaptors
publications.summary: Early-exit adaptors for efficient decoding of output sequences.

publications.name: Patent: Generating Synthetic Conversation Data for Training and Evaluation of Natural Language Models
publications.summary: Synthetic conversation data generation for training and evaluating natural language models.

awards.summary: Selected as 1 of ~1,500 Fellows nationwide from 100K+ applicants; researched Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction for the BioNLP 2016 Competition at IIT Guwahati.
